title: WaterSound 30 North Shingle Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Short walk or bike-ride away from the private beach access and Dunesider pool- Professionally decorated- Private Pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day.- Open-floor plan- Golf cart- 5 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Welcome to 30 North Shingle Lane in WaterSound! This fabulous 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home has been professionally designed with smart and sophisticated interiors with comfort and convenience in mind! It's located just a short walk or bike-ride away from the private beach access and Dunesider pool. The exterior is just as charming as the interior, with a baby blue shingle roof and a white picket fence. It has the quintessential WaterSound curb appeal. The first floor has a spacious living room, kitchen, and dining area. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances and is fully equipped to prepare a gourmet meal. The dining table can also seat up to 10 guests. The laundry close down the hall has a full-size washer and dryer and leads to the screened-in back porch. The porch has an additional dining table to enjoy meals al fresco style as well as cozy seating for your group in the backyard. The primary bedroom is also on this floor and features a comfortable king bed, flat-screen TV, en suite bathroom, and there is a half-bathroom in the hallway. The remaining guest rooms can be found on the second floor. There are 2 bedrooms with a king bed and flat-screen TVs, and the final room has a full-over-full bunk bed with access to the bathroom shared with one of the king bedrooms. There is also a second-floor balcony that has more seating and overlooks the quiet neighborhood. Guests will love the 5 adult bikes and golf cart accompanied by the home for cruising around WaterSound and 30A! At the nearby Hub, you'll find a variety of casual dining and fabulous boutiques, as well as seasonal nightly entertainment for all ages. You don't want to miss your chance to stay at this incredible WaterSound home! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
